interpretation.dns_vs_classic_log_law: DNS deviates ~3.1% from classic log law in log region (y+ 30-36.4)
interpretation.dns_vs_reichardt: Reichardt fits better (~1.5% RMS), as expected for a composite law
interpretation.effective_kappa: DNS implies kappa=0.324 (below classic 0.41) at Re_tau=182
interpretation.finite_re_effect: Lower kappa and higher wake deviation are finite-Reynolds-number effects
